messages:
Maria G: Quick heads-up — planning a stepped rollout for backend v3.2.0 today within the 02:00–06:00 UTC change window. Targets: US -> EU -> APAC. Release notes: https://intranet.redwood/release/v3.2.0 :eyes:
Sam R: Thanks. What's the initial slice and hold durations?
Maria G: Canary 5% for 20m, then 25% for 30m, then 100%. Holdpoints at each step. If any guardrail trips we stop and pin to previous stable.
Chen L: Capacity check: US has 30% spare GPU headroom on the scheduled pool, EU 18% (we can borrow warm nodes if needed), APAC currently 9% — recommend delaying APAC ramp until we confirm warm-pool evictions are clear.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment created by @Maria G — version=v3.2.0 regions=[us,eu,apac] slices=[5%,25%,100%] hold_times=[20m,30m] start=2026-03-20T02:15:00Z
OpsOnCall: Rollback criteria proposal: error-rate >3% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency increase >200ms vs baseline for 10m OR >15% tail-drop on the queue for 3m. If triggered, we pin region to v3.1.9 and route traffic to fallback-quantized model.
Sam R: Confirming pin behavior — pin should be per-region and immediate, with autoscaling frozen for that slice. Is that supported by the deploy controller?
Chen L: Yes — controller supports per-region pins. Command we use: 
```
/deploy pin --region eu --version v3.1.9 --reason "rollback on-ramp"
```
Leo H: Quick note: observability will push evals for the canary prompt-set. If quality drops >2% BLEU-like score on eval harness we treat that as a soft-fail and pause rollout.
Anya P: For APAC, propose staggered start + extended warmup: 10% canary for 45m with pre-warm to avoid cache cold starts. Otherwise we might see p50 spikes.
Maria G: Agreed. New plan: US and EU follow original timing, APAC deferred to T+2h with extended warmup as @Anya P suggested.
OpsOnCall: Additions to rollback runbook: on pin, flip traffic to fallback, run quick smoke suite, then open incident if manual rollback needed. Paging list updated.
deploy-bot: Canary progression will be automated with telemetry gates: error_rate, p99_latency, queue_drop_rate, eval_quality. Auto-stop if any gate fails.
Sam R: I'll monitor US/EU ramps. @Chen L can you confirm node reservations for EU warm-pool now?
Chen L: Reserving 6 nodes in EU pool now. APAC warm-pool heating scheduled at T+1h.
Maria G: Thanks team. Final checklist posted: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/rollout-v3.2.0 — ping me here if you see anything odd during the ramps. :thumbsup:
Leo H: Copy. I'll watch dashboards and the eval webhook.
Anya P: I'll be on standby for APAC warmup and can kick manual pin if needed.
OpsOnCall: Oncall shift covered. I'll trigger rollback if thresholds cross.
Sam R: All good from infra side. Starting canary in US at scheduled time.
deploy-bot: Deployment started in region=us slice=5% status=IN_PROGRESS
Maria G: Good luck — will stand by.
